perQuestion.answer: FLAT_NARROW is neither a single position nor a range algorithm. It is a kind of bot proposal: narrowing a position's range to a fixed product width once a flat (|gap|<2% for 12h) is confirmed. A specific instance exists (e.g. for token 5978579 on cbBTC/WETH), but the name refers to the proposal type.

perQuestion.answer: fetchFreshPool (in src/utils/uniswap.ts) refreshes pool state before minting. It calls factory.getPool, then reads slot0 and liquidity, and builds a new Pool with the same tokens and fee. It is fail-open: if the factory or RPC fails, it returns the old pool. It is wired into useRebalanceExecution and useRotateExecution just before buildMintStep. Caveat: range ticks still come from the plan, computed at the old price, so the range may be slightly off-center after a price move.
